# `missing-pin`: Module instance omits declared ports / 模块实例遗漏了已声明端口

**Severity / 严重程度:** `warning`

## English

### Cause

A module instance leaves one or more declared input, output, or inout ports absent from its connection list.

### Risk

Required inputs may float and outputs may be lost, while an accidental omission can look like an intentionally unused interface.

### Fix

Connect every required port explicitly and document intentionally unused outputs without omitting required inputs or bidirectional signals.

## 简体中文

### 原因

模块实例的连接列表中缺少一个或多个已声明的 input、output 或 inout 端口。

### 风险

必需输入可能悬空、输出可能丢失，而意外遗漏看起来又可能像有意不用该接口。

### 修复

显式连接所有必需端口；对有意不用的输出进行说明，但不要遗漏必需输入或双向信号。

## Failing example / 问题示例

```systemverilog
module missing_pin_child(
  input logic enable,
  input logic data_i,
  output logic data_o,
  inout wire data_bidir
);
  assign data_o = enable & data_i & data_bidir;
endmodule

module missing_pin(input logic enable);
  missing_pin_child child (
    .enable(enable)
  );
endmodule
```

## Fixed example / 修复示例

```systemverilog
module missing_pin_child(
  input logic enable,
  input logic data_i,
  output logic data_o,
  inout wire data_bidir
);
  assign data_o = enable & data_i & data_bidir;
endmodule

module missing_pin(
  input logic enable,
  input logic data_i,
  output logic data_o,
  inout wire data_bidir
);
  missing_pin_child child (
    .enable(enable),
    .data_i(data_i),
    .data_o(data_o),
    .data_bidir(data_bidir)
  );
endmodule
```
